chunks: About a man who closely attaches himself to his wife during the month of Ramadan, so he said: "As long as he does not fear for himself, there is no harm."

key_terms.سَمَاعَةُ: Sama'ah, the narrator asking the Imam عليه السلام
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramadan, the time of obligatory fasting
key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible
key_terms.نَفْسِهِ: himself, meaning his self-control or state
key_terms.يَلْصَقُ: closely attaches himself or keeps close physical contact

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a fasting man to be physically close to his wife in Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a fasting man being physically close to his wife during the month of Ramadan. The ruling is that such closeness is permissible so long as he does not fear falling into what would compromise his fasting.
